## Hardware & Production Constraints (No New Gear)

**Capture**
- Primary: iPhone (high-quality video, stabilization, YouTube Create app available)
- Secondary: MacBook camera or screen recording (QuickTime, OBS Studio)
- Walk energy footage precedent exists (Tookah + camera)

**Audio**
- iPhone mic or existing headphones (from voice walks). Polish in post.

**Visual Sources (already owned)**
- FujiFilm digital (JPG + RAF raws) + Instax Wide Evo
- GoPro footage (see assets below)
- Existing generative clips and animations

**Editing & Polish (installed)**
- DaVinci Resolve (full pro free tier — color, Fairlight audio, Fusion VFX)
- Final Cut Pro
- iMovie
- ffmpeg (installed)

**Graphics & Thumbnails**
- Canva (free tier with Magic Studio)
- Existing brand assets and Midjourney history

**Conclusion:** High production value is achievable through **post-production craft + asset mixing** rather than capture gear. A talking-head + rich B-roll + consistent branding + captions + motion graphics combination can look deliberately produced.

## Templates & Setup Essentials

### Thumbnail Template (highest leverage)
- Size: 1280x720 or 1920x1080
- Structure: Strong headshot or expressive face + large, high-contrast title text (amber/cream on navy or reverse) + small brand element (telescope/wrench or gingko) + subtle texture
- Tools: Canva (create Brand Kit with logo + colors) or direct in Resolve/FCP
- Test: Face + curiosity + specific outcome. Keep text minimal and legible.

**Example title formulas** (honest, spoken cadence):
- "[Specific Action] with My [System] | [Outcome]"
- "Generic AI Fails at X — Here's the [Concrete Fix]"
- "I Built [Thing] Because [Real Pain]"

### Description Template
Hook sentence(s) + full timestamps + key links (related post, site, playlist, offer) + CTA + core + specific tags.

### Other Templates
- Lower thirds / title cards (logo + amber accent)
- 5–10s intro (logo + motion clip + tagline)
- Outro with clear subscribe + next video + playlist CTAs
- Script/outline template (claim → mechanism → proof/demo → implication)
- Editing project template in Resolve (bins + color preset + caption style + text styles)
- Metadata card per video

### Cross-Posting
Follow `CRAFT/Post-Craft/process/cross-posting.md`. YouTube is supported via the existing Buffer prototype when a companion video exists. Always preview and get explicit approval.

## Phased Task List

### Phase 0 — Decisions & Research (0.5–1 day)
- Finalize channel name + handle
- Choose primary day and target length
- Select first 4–8 video topics (start with strong existing thesis)
- Review key sources (06-15 walk-1, Offerings-note, durable observations, Post-Craft style)
- Light keyword research on YouTube for chosen topics

### Phase 1 — Channel Foundation
- Create Google Brand Account + YouTube channel
- Upload profile picture and banner (2560x1440)
- Write About section + add links
- Create core playlists
- Verify channel and configure basic settings

**Bare minimum to publish first video**: Channel exists with basic branding and About.

### Phase 2 — Templates + Asset Preparation (the "setup tax")
- Visual kit: Logo exports, Canva Brand Kit, thumbnail master + 3–5 variants, lower thirds, intro/outro video template
- B-roll library curation (include GoPro clips + character dev videos + Fuji + generative + family scans)
- Content templates (titles, descriptions, outline/script, tags)
- Production templates (recording checklist, Resolve editing project template, export preset)
- Pipeline SOP document (walk/summary → outline → record → edit → thumbnail → metadata → upload → promote)
- Create working folders for raw footage, B-roll, graphics, exports

### Phase 3 — First Video Production & Publish
- Choose topic and write outline in voice
- Record (iPhone or controlled desk setup)
- Edit using template (captions, B-roll mix, graphics, grade)
- Generate thumbnail from master
- Write title + full description + tags
- Upload, optimize (chapters, end screens, cards), schedule or publish
- Announce once (cross-post per existing SOP)

**Bare essentials achieved**: One complete video live on the channel with consistent branding.

### Phase 4 — Cadence & Iteration
- Batch prep where possible
- Maintain simple content calendar
- Review analytics after 3–4 videos (CTR, retention, traffic sources)
- Refine thumbnails, titles, and B-roll mix
- Repurpose strong moments into Shorts
- Expand asset library

---

## Recommended Production Pipeline (Weekly)

1. Source material (recent walk summary, durable observations, live project notes)
2. Create outline (one thesis, spoken register)
3. Record primary footage
4. Gather / generate supporting visuals
5. Edit in Resolve (template-driven)
6. Create thumbnail
7. Write metadata
8. Upload + optimize
9. Cross-post (with approval)
10. Log and archive
